prompts.prompt-r2.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the old town of San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain, at DEEP ASTRONOMICAL NIGHT (around 5:20 in the morning). Tourist viewpoint: the historic center, looking along a cobbled great-house street toward the cathedral of Nuestra Señora de los Remedios with its twin clock towers and rose window, UNESCO-listed colonial grid. Deep night: pitch-dark star-filled sky, moonlit rooftops, faint warm street lamps and lit windows only. NO daylight, NO sunrise glow, NO blue-hour brightness. Main subject centered. No identifiable people. CRITICAL: absolutely no legible text, lettering, numbers, house-number plaques, signs, menu boards, or doorway plaques anywhere in the image — facades and plaques must be blank.
